sentences.en: They spent hours in their favorite MUDs, sparking the first panic about Net addiction.
sentences.vi: Họ đã dành hàng giờ trong MUD yêu thích của mình, làm dấy lên cơn hoảng loạn đầu tiên về chứng nghiện Net.

sentences.en: In order to avoid this sparking, every local instrument in the British Postal Telegraph Department has a " spark " coil connected across the terminals of the electromagnet.

sentences.en: Darren Bridgeman, 34, handed himself in to police in Worcestershire on Thursday night after sparking an international manhunt following the murder.

sentences.en: Technology makes people miserable, sparking technology to avoid the miserable people.

sentences.en: The selections are wonderful choices for sparking an interest in reading in young children and they may inspire older kids to read famous Christmas novels.

sentences.en: From matte earth tones to sparking pinks and purples, Longo's designs cover all the bases!

sentences.en: For example, the page answers questions such as why your power poles are sparking, why your pipes are breaking and why are your buildings distressed.

sentences.en: This eliminates the connection with open battery terminals that can cause sparking, and the quick-start unit is small enough to fit in a glove compartment.

sentences.en: It is still touted as one of the most revolutionary games of all time, sparking a remake on the Nintendo DS known as Super Mario 64 DS.
